events.title: Bark & Blade Patch: Capes, Kennel Pups & UI Frame Pass
events.summary: What's New Capes: your wolf can now wear a cape. You start with the Security Blanket; tattered, warm, the first thing he ever protected. Small armor and health bonus. Other capes show up in your inventory under a Capes section; click to wear, click again to take it off. Hover an icon for stat bonuses. events.title: Bark & Blade: First-Person Fix, World Edges (first area test), Feedback
events.summary: What's New Send feedback right from the title screen: a new icon in the bottom-right of the main menu opens an in-game form for bug reports, suggestions, or general thoughts. Pick a category, type your message, tick "Include game log" if you want us to see what your game was doing, and hit Send. Reports are anonymous on your end; we just see the message and your Steam ID so we can follow up if needed and keep spam out. events.title: Bosses, NG+, Controllers & More
events.summary: This is the biggest Bark'n'Blade update to date. Six unique area bosses with multi-phase fights and cinematic intros now guard the path forward. New Game Plus keeps the challenge going with prestige upgrades and ascending dungeon tiers. Full controller support means you can play the entire game with a gamepad. events.title: Bark'n'Blade - Wildlife, NPCs, Weekly Dungeons & More
events.summary: 14 species of wildlife now roam with realistic day/night behavior, NPCs respond to your barks with hilarious multi-step conversations, weekly dungeon mutators keep every run fresh, and ghost replays let you race against friends. Plus a work in progress update: wolf customization and puppy pack abilities. A Living World The Environment Comes Alive - 14 species of wildlife now roam the game! Elephants graze by day and sleep under the stars. Crocodiles bask in the sun and patrol the water at dusk.

events.title: Bark'n'Blade - Flaming Sword & Performance Boost
events.summary: Find the flaming sword and watch enemies burn. Every area runs smoother now, the Crystal Caves got a massive FPS boost, and the compass minimap got a visual overhaul. What's New Flaming Sword - find and claim a powerful flaming sword that replaces your trusty longsword in the same weapon slot. Press 4 to draw it just like before, but now with fire! events.summary: Meet Captain Snips the pirate crab, earn the Pirate Hat with four special perks, and explore with a new compass rose minimap. events.title: Bark'n'Blade - Dungeons & Major Fixes
events.summary: Dungeons overhauled, dodge is a real stamina commitment, and performance is smoother. Plus a big pile of fixes. What's New Tutorial skip - hold Y at any point during the tutorial to skip it and jump straight into the game. The skip bar is always visible so you know the option is there. More keybinds shown in controls menu - the Confirm (Y) and FPS/LOD Info (~) keys now appear in the keybind list so you always know what does what. What's New XP gain popups - a teal "+X EXP" number now floats above your wolf each time you collect an XP orb from a defeated enemy. events.title: Bark'n'Blade Update - Procedural Dungeons & More
events.summary: Procedural dungeons that regenerate daily, explosive bomb creatures, floating damage numbers, and sunflower fairies that dance to the music. Plus, we're catching you up on a massive backlog of features that shipped without a proper announcement. What's New This Patch Procedural Dungeons - mysterious dungeon entrances now appear throughout the world each day! Every area has random glowing portals that lead to unique, procedurally generated dungeons built from stone corridors, chambers, and crypts
